status: Implemented API catalog; see usage examples and contracts for limits.

functions.name: JEV.PROMPT
functions.what: Ask a typed question over one or more subjects.
functions.usecase: Apply the same typed question to several subjects without writing a separate operator for each task.
functions.output: A decision per subject. output_type is noul, choice, or score; the latter two require criteria.

functions.name: JEV.NOUL
functions.what: Evaluate one proposition about a supplied state.
functions.usecase: Test whether supplied evidence supports one proposition, while preserving an unresolved answer.
functions.output: A Boolean decision in value["0"], or an unresolved observation with its raw probability.

functions.name: JEV.CHOICE
functions.what: Choose from described, caller-supplied options.
functions.usecase: Choose one of a small set of alternatives with explicit descriptions.
functions.output: The selected option ID; inspect the observation for probabilities.

functions.name: JEV.SCORE
functions.what: Rate a subject against ordered levels.
functions.usecase: Assess intensity or quality against ordered levels; use SQL for exact arithmetic.
functions.signature: score(state, rubric_levels, instructions='Rate the subject against the supplied rubric')
functions.output: A numeric ordinal score from 0 to 2 for this three-level rubric.

functions.name: JEV.CLASSIFY
functions.what: Assign subjects to a taxonomy.
functions.usecase: Assign each record to one described category.
functions.output: One category per subject; an unknown option is added automatically.

functions.name: JEV.TAG
functions.what: Evaluate several independent concepts for every subject.
functions.usecase: Apply several independent labels when a record may match more than one.
functions.output: Subject IDs map to concept-indexed decisions; compatible questions share a context.

functions.name: JEV.FILTER
functions.what: Separate matching, rejected and unresolved subjects.
functions.usecase: Keep records that meet a semantic condition and track unresolved membership.
functions.output: matches, rejected and unresolved lists. The supplied population is evaluated exhaustively.

functions.name: JEV.RANK
functions.what: Rank a population using pointwise evaluation.
functions.usecase: Prioritize a population with a shared rubric and preserve equal scores.
functions.output: ranked rows with scores and competition ranks; ties at the cutoff remain included.

functions.name: JEV.COMPARE
functions.what: Compare two supplied values directly.
functions.usecase: Compare two supplied items under one criterion.
functions.output: A left, right or tie decision; insufficient evidence remains UNKNOWN.

functions.name: JEV.RERANK
functions.what: Reorder an existing retrieval shortlist.
functions.usecase: Reorder an existing shortlist using a more specific criterion.
functions.output: Ranked candidates with shortlist scope; this does not establish a corpus-wide top result.

functions.name: JEV.COMPOSITE_SCORE
functions.what: Combine independently scored dimensions.
functions.usecase: Combine several explicit rubric dimensions with chosen weights.
functions.output: Normalized composite and per-dimension decisions. Reweighting reuses compatible raw scores.

functions.name: JEV.EXTRACT
functions.what: Select exact spans from a source.
functions.usecase: Select source passages that satisfy a description without generating missing text.
functions.output: Exact text, source ID and character offsets. Omit candidates to use sentence spans; use many for independent span decisions.

functions.name: JEV.EXTRACT_DATE
functions.what: Normalize supported date expressions with explicit context.
functions.usecase: Find a date in the source and normalize a supported explicit date format.
functions.output: Source spans with normalized dates. Missing context and unsupported expressions stay unresolved.

functions.name: JEV.FIND
functions.what: Find relevant source sentences within a declared corpus.
functions.usecase: Locate passages relevant to a question before further interpretation.
functions.output: Source spans. Pass a registered dataset scope as corpus when needed; scope remains null and mode exhaustive.

functions.name: JEV.STRUCTURE
functions.what: Group adjacent source lines and classify the blocks.
functions.usecase: Group source passages into described sections while retaining their identity.
functions.output: Blocks with line offsets and type decisions; original source text round-trips exactly.

functions.name: JEV.ROUTE
functions.what: Choose a handler and arguments from explicit allowlists.
functions.usecase: Choose an allowed handler for an input; dispatch remains the caller's responsibility.
functions.output: Handler and typed argument decisions. The handler is not executed.

functions.name: JEV.JOIN
functions.what: Join two populations using a semantic predicate.
functions.usecase: Find semantically related pairs across two supplied populations.
functions.signature: join(left, right, predicate, candidate_policy=None, mode='exhaustive', join_type='inner')
functions.output: Accepted edges, unresolved pairs and exhaustive unmatched rows. join_type also supports inner and anti.

functions.name: JEV.ALIGN
functions.what: Propose identity matches and check companion fields.
functions.usecase: Evaluate candidate identity matches without merging stored records.
functions.output: Identity and field-consistency decisions. No IDs are merged.

functions.name: JEV.VERIFY
functions.what: Assess support and opposition for one claim.
functions.usecase: Check whether evidence supports, opposes or leaves a claim unresolved.
functions.output: A support, opposition, conflict or insufficient stance, with separate evidence decisions.

functions.name: JEV.AGGREGATE
functions.what: Run SQL arithmetic over accepted semantic labels.
functions.usecase: Compute a supported aggregate over evaluated decisions and retain coverage.
functions.output: Groups with complete and known-subset values, population counts and unresolved counts. Metrics: count, sum, avg, min, max; default null policy is ignore.

functions.name: JEV.SUMMARY_EXTRACTIVE
functions.what: Select existing sentences for a requested facet.
functions.usecase: Build a summary from selected original passages.
functions.output: Source excerpts and omitted-candidate count. diversity_policy also supports exact_dedup.

functions.name: JEV.RELATE
functions.what: Assess a directed relationship between supplied records.
functions.usecase: Identify described relationships with evidence tied to the source.
functions.signature: relate(left, right, relation_rev, evidence_policy=None, mode='exhaustive', candidate_policy=None)
functions.output: Directed edges, separate support/opposition decisions and whole-source evidence offsets.

functions.name: JEV.COVER
functions.what: Check obligations against an evidence population.
functions.usecase: Check whether supplied evidence covers each declared requirement.
functions.output: A stance and supporting-source IDs for each obligation, scoped to the supplied evidence.

functions.name: JEV.TRACE
functions.what: Reconstruct reported process states from ordered events.
functions.usecase: Identify a bounded event sequence in uniquely timestamped records.
functions.output: Per-entity timelines and possible/current states. Timestamps need offsets and unambiguous ordering.

functions.name: JEV.DISCOVER
functions.what: Propose source-exemplar concepts for review.
functions.usecase: Propose reusable concepts from examples for later human review.
functions.output: Provisional candidate revisions and examples. Holdout content must be separate; promotion is a later reviewer action.

functions.name: JEV.CONTRAST
functions.what: Compare concept rates across disjoint populations.
functions.usecase: Describe differences between declared populations without inferring causation.
functions.signature: contrast(left, right, concepts, unit, mode='exhaustive', discovery_split=None)
functions.output: Rates, denominators, uncertainty bounds and descriptive differences; the declared unit must be unique and cohorts disjoint.

functions.name: JEV.RESOLVE
functions.what: Stop adaptive evaluation when an answer is established.
functions.usecase: Stop evaluating once a declared decision condition is established.
functions.output: An answer, count bounds and wave count; untouched subjects remain NOT_EVALUATED. Also supports count_at_least, count_at_most and exact_count.

functions.name: JEV.STATE_SCAN
functions.what: Evaluate finite-state transitions in parallel under incoming-state hypotheses.
functions.usecase: Process transitions when the caller can describe sufficient state.
functions.output: Conditional transition tables, composed summaries and possible states. Unknown transitions propagate sets.

functions.name: JEV.MATCH
functions.what: Find bounded event patterns with explicit bindings.
functions.usecase: Find bounded multi-record patterns with verified relationships.
functions.output: Verified node-to-record bindings, candidate counts and truncation state.

functions.name: JEV.EVIDENCE_JOIN
functions.what: Evaluate isolated evidence bundles for claims.
functions.usecase: Combine evidence from several sources when no single source is sufficient.
functions.output: Support/opposition stances per singleton or pair bundle; at most eight candidate sources.

functions.name: JEV.EVALUATE
functions.what: Submit explicit typed work items to the shared runtime.
functions.usecase: Submit an explicit set of typed questions with common execution controls.
functions.output: Decisions keyed by work ID, with cache and budget accounting. Set budgets in the outer limits field.

functions.name: JEV.ENSURE_SEMANTICS
functions.what: Fill or reuse semantic observations for subject and concept revisions.
functions.usecase: Reuse compatible observations and schedule only missing semantic work.
functions.output: Concept decisions per subject. Optional evaluator_revs must match the configured pinned model.

functions.name: JEV.MATERIALIZE
functions.what: Publish a generation for an approved concept and registered population.
functions.usecase: Publish resolved values for an approved definition and registered source.
functions.output: A generation, published flag and observations. on_change requires max_refreshes (1–100) and interval_seconds (at least 30).

functions.name: JEV.REFRESH
functions.what: Invalidate specified source dependencies and rebuild selected generations.
functions.usecase: Rebuild a materialized generation after its source dependencies change.
functions.output: Invalidated observation IDs and replacement generations, using the outer execution budget.

functions.name: JEV.REVIEW
functions.what: Save a human assertion without overwriting the model evidence.
functions.usecase: Record a human correction without replacing the original model observation.
functions.output: Saved assertions and confirmation that raw evidence is unchanged.

functions.name: JEV.PROMOTE
functions.what: Approve a provisional concept using independently reviewed evidence.
functions.usecase: Approve a provisional definition after reviewing independent examples.
functions.output: An approved revision ID; no backfill starts until MATERIALIZE.

functions.name: JEV.SELECT_SCHEMA
functions.what: Select relevant authorized tables and fields.
functions.usecase: Select relevant catalog elements for a natural-language objective.
functions.output: Selected tables/columns, catalog alternatives and approved relationship metadata.

functions.name: JEV.PLAN_SQL
functions.what: Construct a staged SQL proposal for a natural-language request.
functions.usecase: Obtain a SQL proposal for inspection without executing it.
functions.output: A reviewable plan and executed=false. A held proposal remains available; this function does not execute SQL.

functions.name: JEV.EXPLAIN_PLAN
functions.what: Estimate missing semantic work before inference.
functions.usecase: Estimate required semantic work before dispatching provider calls.
functions.output: Judgments, conservative requests/cost bounds and policy warnings; this is an estimate, not an approval or guaranteed duration.

functions.name: JEV.CLASSIFY_HIERARCHY
functions.what: Classify along bounded parallel taxonomy frontiers.
functions.usecase: Select a category through a supplied hierarchy when one flat choice is unsuitable.
functions.output: Candidate paths, heuristic weights, dropped branches and unfinished paths.

functions.name: JEV.EXTRACT_TABLE
functions.what: Create typed, source-backed rows using descriptions of records and columns.
functions.usecase: Turn a document into typed rows using descriptions of records and columns.
functions.output: Rows with exact source offsets, typed values and per-cell states. Missing or uncertain values remain unresolved. Four stages run by default. See TEXT_IMPORT.md for automatic insertion.
